creator: Bibliothecarius Modernus
repository: Yale University, Beinecke Rare Book and Manuscript Library
method: Two independent visual readings per side of the native IIIF JPEGs (3042–3120 × 4065–4082 px; SHA-256 in page_manifest.json), text block cut into overlapping strips. Pilot sides 66v, 67r, 68r: Pass 1 fresh Claude agent (Claude Fable 5.1, Claude Code subscription session), Pass 2 google/gemini-3.1-pro-preview via OpenRouter (metered), escalation openai/gpt-5.5 on five line crops (evidence only; one answer rejected). Remaining sides 65r, 65v, 66r, 67v, 68v, 69r, 69v ll. 1–2: Pass 1 and Pass 2 both fresh Claude agents with no access to each other's work, on differently framed image sets (A: 4 strips; B: 3 strips + magnified binding-edge crops). Alignment with tools/transcription_benchmark.py; every disagreement and every (?) cut at line level from the native image and decided by the operator; operator read of every side against the text. Readers saw no catalogue, edition or web source.
normalization: MANUSCRIPT_TRANSCRIPTION_STANDARD.md v1.0: reading text; abbreviations expanded silently following the scribe's spellings; scribe's orthography kept (e/ę → e; ae/oe only where written); u/v by position; always i; scribal capitals only; transcriber's modern punctuation and word division; lines joined; [f. N] at page turns. Text-specific: the scribe's placeholder 'ill.' is printed as written and never expanded to a name; the later gloss 'Aderaldi' is recorded in known_uncertainties/notes only; scribal and later deletions [[…]], additions \…/ (hand discussed in notes); lection marks and marginal cues are object notes. Owner decision 2026-09-20: the reading text prints the manuscript's final transmitted wording (scribal and later corrections/additions adopted, deleted words omitted); the first scribe's reading and every revision are preserved in final/APPARATUS.md and in the v0.9 working text with marks; the later gloss 'Aderaldi' is an identification and is never adopted.

calibration.report: docs/v2/BEINECKE_MS571_PILOT_REPORT.md §5 and pilot/calibration/: same hand B, ff. 64v, 65r ll. 1–6 (Sulpicius Severus, Ep. III) and 69v ll. 3–22 (Gregory, Dial. IV 1). Figures are CLASSIFIED transcription errors of the Claude reader (0 demonstrable in ≈ 320 words); raw WER against the editions (28–43 %) reflects a different recension and is not an error rate. Two Claude readers on 64v/69v disagree at 2.6 % / ≈ 3 % of words (word division excluded). Gemini on 69v: ≈ 9 %.

curator_check.by: operator (Claude Fable 5.1 session) — read of every side against the images; all disagreement sites and flags on native-resolution line crops. NOT a human curator sign-off.

textual_unit.incipit: Fratres karissimi qui ad celebrandam festivitatem sacrosancti confessoris ill. certatim concurritis
textual_unit.explicit: qui in sanctis suis semper est mirabilis nunc et per cuncta secula seculorum amen
textual_unit.author: Anonymous

notes: ≈ 1,425 words; 65r.06–69v.02. Rubric begins at the end of 65r.06. The saint is a bishop in the base text (69r.18–19 'confessoris atque pontificis sanctissimi ill.'); the Aderald gloss is a later application.
